interrupted_gpu_attempt.reason: User laptop reset during first GPU acceptance; not a runtime compatibility conclusion
interrupted_gpu_attempt.acceptance: not verified; rerun both GPU repetitions after daemon recovery

comparison_environment_note: GPU acceptance rerun after user laptop reset; image/source/model/inputs unchanged. Host load and OS caches are uncontrolled; latency is observational, not a controlled hardware-only speedup.

isolation.inference_inputs: questions.jsonl, rulebook.md, calendar.csv and raw data mounted read-only
isolation.labels_and_reports: not mounted; evaluator host reads labels after both containers exit
isolation.outputs: temporary directory outside dataset, cleaned after verification
isolation.model_and_runtime: baked into images; no software/model mounts or downloads during acceptance

limits: Frozen 13-question common-dev subset, not representative PA or full-dataset SLA.
Observed export dates are accepted coverage by user decision; interior missing records are not detectable.
Finite scope/time/rule guards, one aggregation/window, whole-business revenue/order_count on supported CSV shapes.
GPU evidence applies to GTX 1650 / CUDA 12.4 / llama-cpp-python 0.3.16; Blackwell and competition runtime remain unverified.
Worker RSS is not total container memory; GPU memory is sampled whole-device usage.
GPU acceptance was rerun after laptop reset; host load and OS caches uncontrolled.
